about: Text-in, expected-out cases for the Design view's core: the tree outline, the kinds that may stand at a line, and the four operations. A node is selected by the 0-based line it starts on, a position by the 0-based line it sits above, a piece by its file name in the pieces table. Any other implementation of the Design view (a linter, a hosted renderer) can run this file and must give the same answers.
